definitions.explanation: The small, flat, overlapping plates that cover the skin of fish and reptiles.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}の{鱗|うろこ}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: To remove the scales of a fish.

examples.japanese: {蛇|へび}は{鱗|うろこ}で{覆|おお}われている。
{料理|りょうり}する{前|まえ}に、{包丁|ほうちょう}の{背|せ}で{魚|さかな}の{鱗|うろこ}をていねいに{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く。
examples.english: Before cooking, carefully remove the fish scales with the back of a knife.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana (うろこ) or kanji ({鱗|うろこ}). The kanji is relatively uncommon in everyday writing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{目|め}から{鱗|うろこ}が{落|お}ちる (literally, "scales fall from one's eyes") means to have a sudden realization or to see something in a completely new way. This is one of the most well-known expressions using {鱗|うろこ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鱗|うろこ}を{取|と}る: to remove scales
- {鱗|うろこ}が{光|ひか}る: scales glisten
- {目|め}から{鱗|うろこ}: eye-opening realization
